item.aggregated_output:
Request 1:
The training coordinator wants employees to join a waiting list when a session fills up.

Extend `TrainingDesk.enroll(sessionId, email, options?)` with an optional `{ waitlist: boolean }` option. With a free seat, enrollment is still confirmed. When full, opt-in requests return and store status `waitlisted`; requests without opt-in still fail with FULL. Waiting employees are ordered by when they joined. Cancelling a confirmed employee immediately confirms the earliest waiting employee; cancelling a waiting employee simply removes that employee. An employee can have only one entry per session, regardless of status or email casing. Rosters expose both statuses, while attendance exports include only confirmed employees.

Update the existing `submitEnrollment` JSON caller to accept an optional boolean `waitlist` field and return the resulting status. If that field is present but is not boolean, return BAD_REQUEST without changing state. Keep the existing error, normalization, ownership and default enrollment behavior. Add tests covering the new user flows.


Request 2:
The coordinator needs to pause admissions while arranging trainers, without losing a session's waiting list.

Add `TrainingDesk.setAdmissions(sessionId, open)` and expose `admissionsOpen` on its roster; new sessions start open. While closed, every new enrollment request (including waitlist opt-ins) fails with ADMISSIONS_CLOSED. For an existing session this check takes precedence over email or duplicate checks. The portal returns that domain error using its usual failure reply.

Cancellation remains available during a pause, but no waiting employee is promoted until admissions reopen. Reopening fills all available seats from the waiting list in FIFO order. Setting the same state again is harmless. If an open session has a backlog, a new arrival cannot take a seat ahead of that backlog. Session isolation, attendance, waitlist opt-in rules and the other existing contracts still apply. Add tests for pause/cancel/reopen flows.


Request 3:
We are moving the training desk to explicit seat offers because employees need to agree to the date before joining attendance.

Retire automatic confirmation of waiting employees: whenever the previous behavior would promote them, give them status `offered` instead. Offers reserve seats, and only `confirmed` entries appear in attendance. Direct enrollment into an available seat remains immediately confirmed. FIFO waiting order, waitlist opt-in, admissions controls, errors and snapshot ownership remain supported. Existing exports may stay, but callers must observe the new offer behavior.

Add `TrainingDesk.acceptOffer(sessionId, email)` returning the resulting confirmed enrollment, and `TrainingDesk.declineOffer(sessionId, email)` returning void. Both normalize email and check session existence first. A missing entry fails with NOT_ENROLLED; an entry whose status is not offered fails with NOT_OFFERED. Acceptance works even while admissions are paused, since that seat was already reserved. Declining removes the entry and offers the released seat to the next waiting employee only when admissions are open. Existing cancellation also works on offered entries with the same seat-release behavior. Reopening admissions offers every free seat in FIFO order; repeated reopening must not create extra offers or exceed capacity. Offers do not expire in this application.

Keep the portal enrollment and attendance callers consistent with these rules and add tests for the transition. The earlier promise that cancellation or reopening immediately confirms a waiting employee is explicitly retired; the other earlier behavior remains supported.

While closed, every new enrollment request (including waitlist opt-ins) fails with ADMISSIONS_CLOSED. For an existing session this check takes precedence over email or duplicate checks. The portal returns that domain error using its usual failure reply.

Cancellation remains available during a pause, but no waiting employee is promoted until admissions reopen. Reopening fills all available seats from the waiting list in FIFO order. Setting the same state again is harmless. If an open session has a backlog, a new arrival cannot take a seat ahead of that backlog. Session isolation, attendance, waitlist opt-in rules and the other existing contracts still apply. Add tests for pause/cancel/reopen flows.

We are moving the training desk to explicit seat offers because employees need to agree to the date before joining attendance.

Retire automatic confirmation of waiting employees: whenever the previous behavior would promote them, give them status `offered` instead. Offers reserve seats, and only `confirmed` entries appear in attendance. Direct enrollment into an available seat remains immediately confirmed. FIFO waiting order, waitlist opt-in, admissions controls, errors and snapshot ownership remain supported. Existing exports may stay, but callers must observe the new offer behavior.

Add `TrainingDesk.acceptOffer(sessionId, email)` returning the resulting confirmed enrollment, and `TrainingDesk.declineOffer(sessionId, email)` returning void. Both normalize email and check session existence first. A missing entry fails with NOT_ENROLLED; an entry whose status is not offered fails with NOT_OFFERED. Acceptance works even while admissions are paused, since that seat was already reserved. Declining removes the entry and offers the released seat to the next waiting employee only when admissions are open. Existing cancellation also works on offered entries with the same seat-release behavior. Reopening admissions offers every free seat in FIFO order; repeated reopening must not create extra offers or exceed capacity. Offers do not expire in this application.
